Rank 1 Melee Technique

  • Ki Cost: 5 Ki
  • Casting Time: When you take the Attack Action or roll a Combo Attack Roll
  • Range: Self
  • Chargeable?: No
  • Duration: Until the start of your next turn

Push your strikes even further using Ki. Your Unarmed Strike Damage Die is increased by 1 step for the duration.

(1d4>1d6>1d8>1d10>1d12>2d6,> etc)
